name: LRCLIB
summary: Free, open lyrics database with plain and time-synced (LRC) lyrics, searchable by track, artist, album and duration.
description: Community-contributed lyrics records with plain lyrics, synced line timings in LRC form and a structured lyricsfile (YAML) representation, plus instrumental flags. Lookup works by exact track signature (artist, track, album, duration) or by record id, and search works by free text or fields. A beta v2 search returns lightweight summaries without lyric payloads.

auth.notes: Anonymous access works. Registered applications can send Lrclib-App-Id (client side) or Lrclib-Api-Key (server side) for higher limits; invalid values are rejected with 401.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: Requests without it still returned 200, but the docs require client identification and give identified clients a higher limit (about 90 versus 45 requests per minute).

rate_limit.summary: Approximately 45 requests/min per IP for generic clients and about 90/min for identified clients (docs state these may change); 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.

endpoints.summary: Search lyrics records by free text or fields
Beta: lightweight search summaries without lyric text

example.response_excerpt: {"id":19079,"name":"Bohemian Rhapsody","trackName":"Bohemian Rhapsody","artistName":"Queen","albumName":"Stone Cold Classics","duration":355,"instrumental":false,"hasWordSync":false,"plainLyrics":"Is this the real life? Is this just fantasy?...","syncedLyrics":"[00:00.15] Is this the real life? Is this just fantasy?...","lyricsfile":"version: '1.0'\nmetadata:\n  title: Bohemian Rhapsody..."}

license.name: Community-submitted lyrics; no license stated in the API docs

agent_notes: Prefer /api/get with artist, track, album and duration (within a couple of seconds) for an exact match; fall back to /api/search. syncedLyrics is LRC text ([mm:ss.xx] line) when a timed version exists, otherwise null. Honour Retry-After on 429 with jitter. Publishing needs a proof-of-work challenge flow and is out of scope for read use.
caveats: Lyrics are user contributed and are usually copyrighted by their publishers; the API does not grant redistribution rights.
The docs say the stated rate limits are approximations that can change without notice.
/api/get with a deliberately wrong duration (100 s) still returned a record (a different album version), so verify the returned duration and album yourself.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key.
